summary: CONFIG: routine's configured page list for dower includes "/contact", which returns HTTP 404 (Netlify default not-found page). The site's own sitemap.xml lists no /contact URL and llms.txt references contact as the on-page anchor /#contact, so no standalone contact page exists in the site's information architecture. Hypothesis: the page list was authored assuming a separate contact page. Fix the routine config (drop /contact or point it at /#contact), not the site.
